title: Repair Failure Classification v1
description: An agent's reading of one failed baseline-repair round, over the deterministic failure taxonomy. The keyword classifier's first pass travels in the prompt as `prior`; the agent confirms or corrects it from the log tail. Anything that fails validation falls back to the prior, so a model outage or a hallucinated kind can never change what the repair loop does with a log the platform already read. `timeout` is decided by the executor's own timer, never by the model.

kind.description: Must be one of the RepairFailureKind values — the taxonomy the fix planner keys off. An unrecognised kind invalidates the whole output rather than being coerced.

summary.description: The single most diagnostic line from the log, redacted of secret shapes before it is stored.

module.description: Dotted Python module name, only for missing-dependency. The pattern rejects paths and shell fragments so a module name can never steer the fix planner outside the worktree.
